dropDown.label: Reference
dropDown.screentip: What the align and distribute verbs measure against
dropDown.supertip: Anchor uses the last shape you selected. Selection bounds is what PowerPoint does natively.

dropDown.label: Measure
dropDown.screentip: Which rectangle of each shape to align
dropDown.supertip: Shape frame is PowerPoint's own rectangle, which ignores rotation. Visual bounds is what you actually see. Text bounds aligns the text rather than the frame.

editBox.label: Margin (pt)
editBox.screentip: Inset used by the Slide margins reference

button.label: Along curve
button.screentip: Place the shapes along the curve you selected last
button.supertip: Select the shapes, then Ctrl+click an oval, an arc, a line or a freeform last. Round an oval they go at even spacing from twelve o'clock clockwise; along an arc or path they run end to end. Exact (pt) sets the distance between centres along the curve. Rotate shapes, in the Duplicate group, turns each one to follow the curve.

dropDown.label: Space by
dropDown.screentip: Which feature of each shape gets spaced evenly
dropDown.supertip: All four agree when the shapes are the same size, and diverge as soon as they differ.

editBox.label: Exact (pt)
editBox.screentip: Exact spacing in points; leave blank to even out what is already there
editBox.supertip: In the three edge and centre modes this is the pitch. In Space between it is the gap.

button.label: Width
button.screentip: Match every shape's width to the anchor

button.label: Height
button.screentip: Match every shape's height to the anchor

button.label: Both
button.screentip: Match width and height to the anchor

button.label: Rotation
button.screentip: Turn every shape to the anchor's angle
button.supertip: The angle only: flips are left as they are, and each shape turns about its own centre. Works on groups, because turning a group does not change the spacing inside it.

toggleButton.label: From centre
toggleButton.screentip: Hold each shape's centre while resizing instead of its top-left corner

dropDown.label: Direction
dropDown.screentip: Whether the margin makes the shapes smaller or larger than the anchor
dropDown.supertip: Shrink puts each shape inside the anchor, Grow puts it outside. With Cascade and Grow the shape you selected first ends largest, the mirror of Shrink.

editBox.label: Margin (pt)
editBox.screentip: How far each shape sits inside or outside the anchor, measured on each side
editBox.supertip: A margin of 10 leaves a 10pt border all round, so each dimension changes by 20. Always a positive number: Direction decides whether the shapes shrink inside the anchor or grow past it. Turn From centre on for concentric rings. This is not the slide margin in the Align to group.

dropDown.label: Apply margin
dropDown.screentip: Whether the margin applies at all, and whether it accumulates
dropDown.supertip: All the same puts every shape one margin from the anchor. Cascade tiers them along the order you selected in: with Shrink the first shape you selected ends smallest, with Grow it ends largest.

button.label: Stack
button.screentip: Stack the selection in the order you selected it
button.supertip: The first shape you selected ends on top and the last at the bottom. Shapes you did not select keep their own layer.

button.label: Reverse
button.screentip: Stack the selection in reverse selection order
button.supertip: The mirror image of Stack: the first shape you selected ends at the bottom.

editBox.label: Columns
editBox.screentip: Leave blank for a near-square grid

button.label: Grid
button.screentip: Arrange the selection into an even grid, leaving sizes alone

editBox.label: X (pt)
editBox.screentip: How far each copy moves right of the one before; negative moves left

editBox.label: Y (pt)
editBox.screentip: How far each copy moves down from the one before; negative moves up

editBox.label: Angle
editBox.screentip: How far each copy turns from the one before, in degrees clockwise
editBox.supertip: The turn happens about the Pivot, before the X and Y move. 0 turns nothing.

dropDown.label: Pivot
dropDown.screentip: The point each copy turns about
dropDown.supertip: Own centre spins each shape in place. Selection centre turns the whole selection as one piece. Anchor centre turns about the shape you selected last, and Slide centre about the middle of the slide.

toggleButton.label: Rotate shapes
toggleButton.screentip: Turn shapes as well as moving them
toggleButton.supertip: On, each copy turns with the step, and Distribute along curve turns each shape to follow the curve. Off, shapes keep their angle and only their positions change.

button.label: Duplicate
button.screentip: Make copies of the selection, each one step on from the last
button.supertip: A multi-shape selection is copied as a unit and groups stay groups. The originals and the copies are left selected, ready for the next command. Undo removes every copy at once.
Reverses one AlignPro operation and names it. Ctrl+Z does the same thing.
